## a2d9d069c7d5

**Reproduced metadata/contract defect; no semantic-rule defect claimed.**  At
source SHA-256
`a9bfd8dc636a8ed242ce89c21f4fa6a977c809a5672f637891f5e1d684824e29`,
all three names in `DEGENERATE_TEXTURES` (`min_blocks`, `max_density`, and
`one_big_square`) produce 16×16 grids that pass `self_check` with zero errors,
but the module does not declare `LAWFUL_DEGENERATE_TEXTURES`.  Therefore the
strict defect linter flags texture-domain overlap and cannot tell whether these
are intentionally lawful diagnostic cases or mislabeled degenerates.

The direct reproduction is
`checks/audit/a2d9d069c7d5/reproduction.json`; the strict linter receipt is
`checks/audit/a2d9d069c7d5/defect_lint/result.json`.  I checked all three fixed
layouts, their validator results, the declaration surface, and the source hash.
No source was edited because this is an audit-only target.
